+import argparse
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+def update_version(version: str):
+    file_path = Path("fastapi/__init__.py")
+    content = file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    new_content = re.sub(r'__version__ = "[^"]+"', f'__version__ = "{version}"', content)
+    if content == new_content:
+        print(f"Version {version} already set in fastapi/__init__.py")
+    else:
+        file_path.write_text(new_content, encoding="utf-8")
+        print(f"Updated fastapi/__init__.py to version {version}")
+
+def update_release_notes(version: str):
+    file_path = Path("docs/en/docs/release-notes.md")
+    lines = file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(keepends=True)
+    
+    new_lines = []
+    found_latest_changes = False
+    for line in lines:
+        new_lines.append(line)
+        if line.strip() == "## Latest Changes":
+            new_lines.append(f"## {version}\n\n")
+            found_latest_changes = True
+            
+    if not found_latest_changes:
+        print("Could not find '## Latest Changes' in release-notes.md")
+        sys.exit(1)
+        
+    file_path.write_text("".join(new_lines), encoding="utf-8")
+    print(f"Inserted version {version} into release-notes.md")
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Release FastAPI")
+    parser.add_argument("version", help="The new version string (e.g. 0.136.4)")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    
+    update_version(args.version)
+    update_release_notes(args.version)
+    
+    print("Adding release date...")
+    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/add_latest_release_date.py"], capture_output=True, text=True)
+    if result.returncode == 0:
+        print(result.stdout)
+    else:
+        print(f"Error adding release date: {result.stderr}")
+        sys.exit(result.returncode)
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
